new_nodes.title: Embedder configuration pipeline — plugin.json defaults through brain_meta overrides to model loading
new_nodes.content:
Complete config flow: plugin.json 'config.embedder' section → _EMBEDDER_DEFAULTS dict → brain_meta table overrides → embedder.load_model(config) → 3-step fallback chain (local path → HuggingFace → pip brain-embedding → auto-install). Key functions: _get_embedder_config() reads from brain_meta with plugin.json fallbacks, set_embedder_config() writes to brain_meta for runtime model swapping. Users can change models without code changes via one call: brain.set_embedder_config(model_name='nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5-Q', dim=768, pooling='mean'). Takes effect on next boot.

Components synthesized: plugin.json config (id:20c9e116), pipeline concept (id:1976ded1), config functions (id:57d27bdf, id:96488c8a), load_model fallback chain (id:f872fd93).

new_nodes.title: Behavioral mirror: heartbeat queries brain with Claude's state, surfaces self-knowledge
new_nodes.content:
Heartbeat evolved from simple message counter to behavioral mirror. Current: nudges at message threshold 8. Proposed enhancement: summarize Claude's recent behavior (building, discussing, encoding patterns) → query brain with behavioral description → surface relevant self-reflections in nudge.

Example flow: 5 messages, 0 encodes, heavy code output → query "building without encoding" → surface compression instinct node → nudge: "You're in build mode with no encodes. A previous you lost all ripple engine reasoning this way."

Makes self-knowledge associative, not rule-based. Implementation: modify post_response_track to build behavioral summary, call recall with summary, include findings in nudge. From (id:6ac0de63) and (id:a22349d2).

new_nodes.title: Encoding agent 2-round architecture: remember_batch with connect_to eliminates separate connection round
new_nodes.content:
Current encoding agent design (post-v3+ rewrite): Round 1 uses remember_batch() with connect_to[] parameter to create ALL new nodes AND connect them to existing nodes via fuzzy title matching in a single call. Auto_connect=True handles inter-node connections. Round 2 is journal + DONE. This replaced the 3-round pattern (R1 batch creates, R2 batch connects, R3 journal) and individual calls (7 remember + 6 find_node_by_title). The 500-char timeline snippets provide sufficient context to eliminate get_node calls entirely.

Evolution: v3+ 3-round pattern (id:16b0e4f4) → 2-round decision (id:bf168f95) → full rewrite implementation (id:ce1d490d). Key insight: connect_to parameter in remember_batch eliminates the need for a separate connection round.
